# Third-Party Runtime Assets

The files in this directory are redistributed for local browser loading:

- Lucide 1.49.0, ISC License: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
- Three.js 0.164.1, MIT License: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.22-rc.20250304, Apache License 2.0: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
- DM Sans variable font 5.2.8, SIL Open Font License 1.1: https://github.com/googlefonts/dm-fonts

Upstream version numbers are pinned so production behavior does not change when a CDN publishes a new release.

Full license texts: THREE-LICENSE.txt, LUCIDE-LICENSE.txt,
MEDIAPIPE-LICENSE.txt and DM-SANS-OFL.txt in this directory.

The Hand Landmarker model is NOT redistributed in the public repository.
See the README for the official download and applicable model terms.
All public demo images are original geometric placeholders, licensed under
the project MIT license; original prototype photos and scraped posts are excluded.
